Hand-made slim Wikidata records (the shape `enrichment/wikidata_client.slim()` produces)
for the T-U5 / T-U6 unit tests. Q5, Q96, Q668, Q928, Q1498, Q213854 and the class QIDs
in category_rules.yaml are real; items numbered Q9000000xx are stand-ins with the same
structure as the real ones, so the tests never need the network.
